rules.title: Provisional POSH Internal Committee threshold review
rules.description: Evaluates the existing GrowWithHR ten-employee product threshold using confirmed assessment facts while preserving legal-review and per-location limitations.

matched.reason: The organisation reported at least 10 employees and supplied an Indian operating state and location count. The current product threshold is crossed, but legal review and per-office or administrative-unit facts remain required before an applicability conclusion is presented as approved.

recommendation.title: Review the POSH Internal Committee requirement
recommendation.action: Confirm employee distribution across each office or administrative unit and obtain qualified legal review before treating the Internal Committee conclusion as approved.
recommendation.timeline: Before relying on the product result as a legal conclusion
limitations: The assessment captures total employee count, not employee count for each office or administrative unit.
This result is a deterministic product review flag and not legal approval.

notMatched.reason: The reported total employee count is below the current GrowWithHR ten-employee Internal Committee threshold. This outcome does not assess or remove broader POSH duties.

missing.reason: Employee count, primary operating state and permanent location count are required before the current product threshold can be evaluated.

recommendation.title: Confirm the POSH threshold facts
recommendation.action: Confirm total employee count, primary operating state and permanent location count. Do not use retrieval or a language model to infer missing answers.
recommendation.timeline: Before evaluating the POSH product threshold
limitations: No applicability conclusion has been reached.
Employee distribution by office or administrative unit is not captured by the current assessment.

sourceSections.purpose: Procedural source; exact mapping remains pending legal review

limitations: The rule mirrors the existing GrowWithHR product threshold and must not be represented as independently approved legal advice.
The current assessment does not capture employee count separately for every office or administrative unit.
A below-threshold result concerns only the current product Internal Committee trigger and does not assess broader POSH obligations.
Retrieval and language models must not create or change assessment facts or applicability results.
